problem_statement:
fix(recovery): record recovered panics in c.Errors

## Summary
- Record recovered panics on the context error list in the default recovery handler.
- Preserve the existing 500 response behavior for normal recovered panics.
- Add a regression test showing upstream middleware can observe the recovered panic via `c.Errors`.

Fixes #2088

## Root cause
`RecoveryWithWriter` delegates non-broken-pipe panics to `defaultHandleRecovery`, but the default handler only called `AbortWithStatus(http.StatusInternalServerError)`. Unlike the broken-pipe path, it did not call `c.Error(...)`, so middleware earlier in the chain could not inspect recovered panics through `c.Errors` after `c.Next()` returned.

## Test plan
- [x] `go test . -run 'TestPanicInHandlerRecordsError|TestPanicInHandler|TestPanicWithBrokenPipe|TestPanicWithAbortHandler|TestCustomRecoveryWithWriter|TestPanicWithAbort' -count=1 -v`
- [x] `git diff --check`

I also ran `go test . -count=1`; it hit pre-existing Windows/environment-specific failures unrelated to this change:
- `TestSaveUploadedFileWithPermission` expected Unix-style `0777` permissions but got `0755` on this environment.
- `TestUnixSocket` failed to connect to a Unix socket under the Windows temp path.
- `TestFileDescriptor` expected an error but got nil on this environment.
